sections.narrative: Fire crew arrived on scene for a witnessed sudden collapse following chest tightness and diaphoresis at a backyard barbecue. Patient was found unresponsive and pulseless. High-quality CPR was initiated immediately, AED pads were placed, and ventilations were provided with oxygen at 15 L/min with good chest rise. Initial AED analysis advised no shock, followed by a second analysis advising a shock, which was delivered with immediate resumption of compressions. Paramedic crew arrived on scene and care was transferred.
